bundled_k5_note.label: projection, not measured
bundled_k5_note.explanation: The 131.1 ms figure was a theoretical projection calculated during the Step 1.5 speed probe (24 passes of a 5-step unrolled dummy model x ~5.4 ms/pass). No bundled-k5 model was trained or deployed for this baseline. The real measured single-step baseline takes 568 ms on this CPU (0.47x solver speed).
